links.outcome: Accuracy of colonoscopy interval advice, standard GPT-4 versus guideline-contextualized GPT-4
links.effect: The contextualized GPT4 model outperformed the standard GPT4 in all domains. No high-risk features were missed, and only two cases had hallucination of additional high-risk features.
